theorems.name: clamp_in_range
theorems.doc: (S) Every stored configuration value is within its field's range (the eye renderer and the colour packing rely on it).
theorems.proof:
theorem clamp_in_range (f : Field) (v : Std.I32) {lo hi r}
    (hr : range f = ok (lo, hi)) (hc : clamp_field f v = ok r) :
    lo.val ≤ r.val ∧ r.val ≤ hi.val := by
  unfold clamp_field at hc
  rw [hr] at hc
  have hlh : lo.val ≤ hi.val := by
    cases f <;> simp [range] at hr <;> obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hr <;> decide
  by_cases h1 : v.val < lo.val <;> by_cases h2 : hi.val < v.val <;>
    simp [h1, h2] at hc <;> subst hc <;> scalar_tac

theorems.name: clamp_keeps_in_range
theorems.doc: (S) A value already in range is stored as submitted.
theorems.proof:
theorem clamp_keeps_in_range (f : Field) (v : Std.I32) {lo hi}
    (hr : range f = ok (lo, hi)) (h1 : lo.val ≤ v.val) (h2 : v.val ≤ hi.val) :
    clamp_field f v = ok v := by
  unfold clamp_field
  rw [hr]
  have n1 : ¬ v.val < lo.val := by omega
  have n2 : ¬ hi.val < v.val := by omega
  simp [n1, n2]

theorems.name: expression_codes
theorems.doc: (S) Exactly the documented codes are taken.
theorems.statement:
theorem expression_codes (c : Std.I32) :
    expression_ok c = ok (decide ((1 ≤ c.val ∧ c.val ≤ 5) ∨ (7 ≤ c.val ∧ c.val ≤ 10)))
theorems.proof:
theorem expression_codes (c : Std.I32) :
    expression_ok c = ok (decide ((1 ≤ c.val ∧ c.val ≤ 5) ∨ (7 ≤ c.val ∧ c.val ≤ 10))) := by
  unfold expression_ok
  by_cases a : (1 : Int) ≤ c.val <;> by_cases b : c.val ≤ 5 <;>
    by_cases d : (7 : Int) ≤ c.val <;> by_cases e : c.val ≤ 10 <;>
    simp [a, b, d, e] <;> omega

theorems.name: wifi_refuses_bad_name
theorems.doc: (S) An empty AP name, or one over 32 bytes, is refused (upstream stores it as an empty name and restarts into it).
theorems.statement:
theorem wifi_refuses_bad_name (len : Std.U32) (h : len.val = 0 ∨ len.val > 32) :
    wifi_set true len = ok Wifi.Refuse
theorems.proof:
theorem wifi_refuses_bad_name (len : Std.U32) (h : len.val = 0 ∨ len.val > 32) :
    wifi_set true len = ok Wifi.Refuse := by
  unfold wifi_set
  have hm : SSID_MAX_LEN.val = 32 := by unfold SSID_MAX_LEN; rfl
  rcases h with h | h
  · simp [h]
  · have h0 : ¬ len.val = 0 := by omega
    have h1 : SSID_MAX_LEN.val < len.val := by omega
    simp [h0, h1]

theorems.name: wifi_stores_only_valid_name
theorems.doc: (S) A name is stored only if it is 1 to 32 bytes.
theorems.statement:
theorem wifi_stores_only_valid_name (len : Std.U32) (h : wifi_set true len = ok Wifi.StoreAndRestart) :
    0 < len.val ∧ len.val ≤ 32
theorems.proof:
theorem wifi_stores_only_valid_name (len : Std.U32) (h : wifi_set true len = ok Wifi.StoreAndRestart) :
    0 < len.val ∧ len.val ≤ 32 := by
  unfold wifi_set at h
  have hm : SSID_MAX_LEN.val = 32 := by unfold SSID_MAX_LEN; rfl
  by_cases a : len.val = 0
  · simp [a] at h
  · by_cases b : SSID_MAX_LEN.val < len.val
    · simp [a, b] at h
    · constructor <;> omega

theorems.name: pending_save_before_restart
theorems.doc: (S) A configuration change answered `204` is saved before any restart.
theorems.statement: theorem pending_save_before_restart : save_before_restart true = ok true
theorems.proof:
theorem pending_save_before_restart : save_before_restart true = ok true := by
  simp [save_before_restart]

theorems.name: ota_post_only
theorems.statement: theorem ota_post_only (b t : Bool) (n m : Std.U32) : ota_start false b t n m = ok OtaStart.MethodNotAllowed
theorems.proof:
theorem ota_post_only (b t : Bool) (n m : Std.U32) : ota_start false b t n m = ok OtaStart.MethodNotAllowed := by
  simp [ota_start]

theorems.name: ota_one_at_a_time
theorems.statement: theorem ota_one_at_a_time (t : Bool) (n m : Std.U32) : ota_start true true t n m = ok OtaStart.Conflict
theorems.proof:
theorem ota_one_at_a_time (t : Bool) (n m : Std.U32) : ota_start true true t n m = ok OtaStart.Conflict := by
  simp [ota_start]

theorems.name: ota_stream_bounded
theorems.doc: (S) An image is streamed only if it is not empty and fits the slot.
theorems.statement:
theorem ota_stream_bounded (b t : Bool) (n m : Std.U32) (h : ota_start true b t n m = ok OtaStart.Stream) :
    b = false ∧ t = true ∧ 0 < n.val ∧ n.val ≤ m.val
theorems.proof:
theorem ota_stream_bounded (b t : Bool) (n m : Std.U32) (h : ota_start true b t n m = ok OtaStart.Stream) :
    b = false ∧ t = true ∧ 0 < n.val ∧ n.val ≤ m.val := by
  unfold ota_start at h
  cases b <;> cases t <;> simp at h
  split_ifs at h with h1 <;> simp at h
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> scalar_tac

theorems.name: ota_first_sector_magic
theorems.doc: (S) The first sector is written only if it starts with the image magic.
theorems.statement: theorem ota_first_sector_magic (b : Std.U8) (w : Bool) (h : sector_ok true b w = ok true) : b = ESP_IMAGE_MAGIC
theorems.proof:
theorem ota_first_sector_magic (b : Std.U8) (w : Bool) (h : sector_ok true b w = ok true) : b = ESP_IMAGE_MAGIC := by
  unfold sector_ok at h
  by_cases hb : b = ESP_IMAGE_MAGIC
  · exact hb
  · simp_all

theorems.name: ota_restart_only_committed
theorems.doc: (S) The device restarts into an upload only if it streamed and committed.
theorems.statement: theorem ota_restart_only_committed (s c : Bool) (h : ota_done s c = ok true) : s = true ∧ c = true
theorems.proof:
theorem ota_restart_only_committed (s c : Bool) (h : ota_done s c = ok true) : s = true ∧ c = true := by
  unfold ota_done at h
  cases s <;> cases c <;> simp_all

Wifi.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive Wifi where
| StoreAndRestart : Wifi
| Refuse : Wifi

range.lean:
def range (f : Field) : Result (Std.I32 × Std.I32) := do
  match f with
  | Field.PupilLength => ok (20#i32, 120#i32)
  | Field.WiggleAmp => ok (0#i32, 400#i32)
  | Field.BlinkInterval => ok (60#i32, 600#i32)
  | Field.EyeRed => ok (0#i32, 31#i32)
  | Field.EyeGreen => ok (0#i32, 63#i32)
  | Field.EyeBlue => ok (0#i32, 31#i32)
  | Field.SoundThreshold => ok (10#i32, 400#i32)
  | Field.SinRarity => ok (0#i32, 100#i32)
  | Field.EyerollRarity => ok (0#i32, 100#i32)
  | Field.StartledRarity => ok (0#i32, 100#i32)
  | Field.SuspiciousRarity => ok (0#i32, 100#i32)
  | Field.AngryRarity => ok (0#i32, 100#i32)
  | Field.YawnRarity => ok (0#i32, 100#i32)
  | Field.DelightRarity => ok (0#i32, 100#i32)
  | Field.DizzyRarity => ok (0#i32, 100#i32)

expression_ok.lean:
def expression_ok (code : Std.I32) : Result Bool := do
  if code >= 1#i32
  then
    if code <= 5#i32
    then ok true
    else if code >= 7#i32
         then ok (code <= 10#i32)
         else ok false
  else if code >= 7#i32
       then ok (code <= 10#i32)
       else ok false

ota_done.lean:
def ota_done (streamed : Bool) (committed : Bool) : Result Bool := do
  if streamed
  then ok committed
  else ok false

wifi_set.lean:
def wifi_set (given : Bool) (len : Std.U32) : Result Wifi := do
  if given
  then
    if len = 0#u32
    then ok Wifi.Refuse
    else if len > SSID_MAX_LEN
         then ok Wifi.Refuse
         else ok Wifi.StoreAndRestart
  else ok Wifi.StoreAndRestart

save_before_restart.lean:
def save_before_restart (save_pending : Bool) : Result Bool := do
  ok save_pending

ota_start.lean:
def ota_start
  (post : Bool) (busy : Bool) (has_target : Bool) (total : Std.U32)
  (max_size : Std.U32) :
  Result OtaStart
  := do
  if post
  then
    if busy
    then ok OtaStart.Conflict
    else
      if has_target
      then
        if total = 0#u32
        then ok OtaStart.BadRequest
        else
          if total > max_size
          then ok OtaStart.BadRequest
          else ok OtaStart.Stream
      else ok OtaStart.NoTarget
  else ok OtaStart.MethodNotAllowed

OtaStart.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive OtaStart where
| MethodNotAllowed : OtaStart
| Conflict : OtaStart
| NoTarget : OtaStart
| BadRequest : OtaStart
| Stream : OtaStart

clamp_field.lean:
def clamp_field (f : Field) (v : Std.I32) : Result Std.I32 := do
  let (lo, hi) ← range f
  if v < lo
  then ok lo
  else if v > hi
       then ok hi
       else ok v

sector_ok.lean:
def sector_ok
  (first : Bool) (first_byte : Std.U8) (write_ok : Bool) : Result Bool := do
  if first
  then if first_byte != ESP_IMAGE_MAGIC
       then ok false
       else ok write_ok
  else ok write_ok
